text:
Anya: Heads-up — the drilldown on the new eval dashboard shows a blank per-metric breakdown for quantized runs when sample_count < 50. Happens only in the tree view, table still shows rows. https://console.redwood.ai/dash/ev/12ab34 (screenshot pasted)
Sam: repro steps? which model/runner?
Anya: model: opt-6.7q8 (quantized) -> runner: ci-eval-v2. Payload = 8 prompt templates, low-sample run from last night. Click metric node -> empty panel.
Matt: I can repro. UI transform drops `metricId` when `sample_count` is falsy. treewalk plumbing expects `metric_key`.
Joanna: FYI CI had a frontend deploy earlier, @ci-bot did a deploy around 1958216600
ci-bot: deploy: frontend/main@d6f2 -> prod (1958216600) :rocket:
Matt: quick patch idea: in src/ui/treewalk.ts replace `node.metricId` with `node.metric_key || node.metricId` and add a nullguard around `node.samples.length`.
Anya: I'll open a tiny PR and add an integration case for quantized runs with sample_count < 50.
DevX: runner-side hygiene would help too. Can we ensure the eval runner emits sample_count as an explicit int? sometimes JSON nulls slip through from the merge step.
Sam: runner patch suggestion:
```
if (typeof sample_count !== 'number') sample_count = Number(sample_count) || 0
```
Joanna: also add an e2e dashboard test: expand the drilldown fixture to include both `metric_key` and `metricId` variants so the UI covers both shapes.
insights-bot: related alerts: eval-dashboard-errors increased by 1 in last 24h. Recent runs: /insights/runs?since=24h
Anya: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/frontend/pull/4821 — adds the nullguard + test. Will run staging smoke and report.
Matt: if staging looks good we should ship a patch release. marking as high-priority for the next patch window.
Anya: ack. I'll monitor staging and post results here. (reacts :eyes:)
